$comment: What every setting in this section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file. See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

prVideo.specPatterns.does: The e2e specs whose recordings demo a PR (empty: no spec is ever picked).

prVideo.videosDir.does: Where the Playwright reporter writes the raw videos, the step logs and the manifest.

prVideo.storageBranch.does: The branch the published videos are stored on.

prVideo.backendPaths.does: Globs of backend code (empty: the paths of every service whose kind is not `frontend`).

prVideo.neutralPaths.does: Globs that count as neither frontend nor backend.

prVideo.api.extractor.does: The built-in route extractor the API changes section reads endpoints with.

prVideo.api.sources.does: The source files the route extractor reads.

prVideo.api.exclude.does: Source files the route extractor leaves out.

prVideo.api.openapi.does: OpenAPI documents the API changes section compares instead of extracted routes.

prVideo.recordCmd.does: How the specs are run in demo mode (`{specs}`: the changed spec files).

prVideo.slotWaitSec.does: How long the demo video step waits for a free test-stack slot.

prVideo.localTimeoutSec.does: How long the whole local demo video step may take.

prVideo.testTimeoutSec.does: The shortest timeout a test gets in demo mode, so a spec's own timeout cannot cut a recording short.

video.narration.enabled.does: Speaks each step of a demo video (`false`: silent videos with subtitles).

video.narration.voice.does: The Kokoro voice of the narration.

video.narration.model.does: The narration model (only the quantized one is pinned).

video.size.width.does: The recording width and viewport in demo mode.

video.size.height.does: The recording height and viewport in demo mode.

video.ffmpeg.does: A path to the team's own ffmpeg build (`null`: the pinned one).

video.licenceReview.does: `strict` turns narration off while any of its licence items is pending review.

video.script.scope.does: Which videos the demo-narrator agent writes a script for.

video.script.timeoutSec.does: The normal time the narrator may take.

video.script.maxSegments.does: The most narrated lines in a script.

video.script.minWordsPerAction.does: The words a line needs per user action it covers.

video.script.speakEvidence.does: Narrates evidence videos aloud too (`false`: subtitled and silent).

video.bugPair.enabled.does: Records a before-the-fix video for UI bugs.

video.bugPair.requireBefore.does: A bug whose reproduction cannot be shown before the fix opens no PR (the delivery escalates).

video.apiEvidence.enabled.does: Shows a backend bug's requests before and after the fix.

video.apiEvidence.headers.does: The request and response headers shown (credentials are masked by name whatever this says).

video.apiEvidence.maxBodyBytes.does: A body is cut at this size.

video.apiEvidence.maxPairs.does: Request pairs shown per bug in the PR; the rest are collapsed.

video.apiEvidence.paymentBodies.does: A payment exchange shows only its method, path and status (`withhold`), or its headers and bodies with card data masked (`mask`).

video.pacing.stepDelaySec.does: While recording: the pause before each step.

video.pacing.holdSec.does: While recording: the hold after each visible change.

video.pacing.typeDelaySec.does: While recording: the delay between typed characters.

video.pacing.cursorSec.does: While recording: the time a cursor move takes.

video.pacing.pauseSec.does: In the rendered video: the pause after each narrated line.
